jobs_results.title: PHP developer (Hybrid, Barcelona based candidates ONLY)
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a PHP developer to join the team.

Requires going to the office at least 3 days a week.

Job description

About the role:

We are seeking a Developer with experience in PHP and Odoo and a background in e-commerce, passionate about Data, AI, and automation.

Specific responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain efficient web applications using PHP as the core language and Python.
• Manage server-side logic to optimize performance and functionality.
• Integrate databases, using technologies such as AWS RDS, MySQL, Postgress.
• Design and maintain APIs to facilitate communication between systems and services.
• Collaborate with other team members, including designers and front-end developers, to ensure consistency in application development.
• Implement security measures to protect against vulnerabilities and ensure data integrity.
• Perform testing and debugging to ensure code quality.
• Maintain clear and concise code documentation.
•... Keeping up to date with the latest trends and developments in web development.

Skills and Requirements:
• 2 years experience in software development PHP and Odoo, preferable within e-commerce companies or heavy transactional companies.
• Good Interpersonal skills, able to adapt to multiple changes and explain his areas of expertise. Resilient, proactive and communicative.
• A minimum of 3 years with cloud-based infrastructure like AWS.
• System Engineering: Solid understanding of system engineering, including networking, Linux operating systems and databases.
• Technology:
• PHP - Symphony
• Container: Docker
• DevOps
• Docker/k8s
• Experience with CI/CD

What we have to offer
• Indefinite contract.
• Flex time & 2 remote workdays.
• Attractive compensation according to experience.
• Flexible remuneration with Cobee.
• Nice office located in Sant Just Desvern with free drinks, fruit and snacks.

If you are motivated by challenges, being part of an innovative company and an incredible team, we look forward to your application.

jobs_results.title: Programador/a php (teletrabajo híbrido)
jobs_results.description:
Desde Oxigent Technologies seleccionamos un/a Desarrollador/a PHP para participar en proyectos dentro de una empresa especializada en el desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas para el sector telemedicina, ubicada en Barcelona.

En el caso de ser la persona seleccionada, tu misión será el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades y evolutivos para el producto estrella de la compañía, una novedosa plataforma que permite integrar diferentes funcionalidades y herramientas para proyectos de telemedicina.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?

- Desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades, evolutivos y mantenimiento de la plataforma
- Desarrollo de componentes reutilizables, garantizando la entrega oportuna de software.
- Escribir código bien diseñado, estable y eficiente.

Para ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar?

- A partir de 3 años de experiencia
- Profundos conocimientos en PHP
- Profundos conocimientos en Doctrine u otros ORMs
- Profundos conocimientos en SQL
- Experiencia con RabbitMQ
- Experiencia... en sistemas de cache (Memcached, Redis)
- Experiencia en WebSockets
- Experiencia en desarrollo y consumo de servicios web (JSONRPC, REST, SOAP)
- Experiencia con aplicaciones de alto rendimiento
- Experiencia en contenedores: Docker, docker-compose, Kubernetes

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

- Contratación indefinida a través de Oxigent.
- Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (entre 38.000 - 43.000 euros brutos anuales).
- Horario flexible.
- Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo (3 días remoto y 2 en oficina)
- Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.
- Seguro médico privado.
- Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.
- Aplicación de acceso a gimnasios y actividades deportivas en toda España con descuentos.
- ¡Y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Senior PHP Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

We are looking for a PHP Developer to join our fast-growing team and assist in the drive of the company's growth.

What You’ll Do
• Translate business requirements into technical deliverables
• Develop additional features on existing applications
• Take ownership of work and see it all the way... through the software development life cycle
• Investigate and resolve defects in the established system
• Help define non-functional requirements and build systems capable of meeting them
• Deliver operationally stable software and help ensure uptime
• Build processes to provide an excellent customer experience
• Improve automation of our CICD processes
• Deliver API enabled components and microservices
• Be part of a distributed Agile team and contribute to its success and improvement
• Mentor junior members of the team
• Design and implement solution architecture to meet functional and non-functional requirements.

What You’ll Bring
• Master’s in Computer Science with at least +8 years of commercial experience
• Full professional proficiency in English
• Excellent communication and inter-personal skills
• Extensive experience developing PHP applications and hands-on experience working with at least one of its mainstream frameworks (e.g. Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony, Yii2, Phalcon or Zend)
• Proficient with Agile methodologies, CI, TDD/BDD, SQL/NoSQL databases and REST/SOAP webservices.
• Hands on experience with legacy PHP frameworks
• Hands on experience with modern PHP frameworks
• Experience within a microservices / DevOps environment (Docker, Kubernetes)
• A can-do, problem-solving attitude & work well as part of a team
• Experience mentoring developers

SOBRE NOSOTROS

Selecciona 3 Programadores con experiencia mínima de 2-3 años en desarrollo de aplicaciones con PHP para incorporación inmediata en amplio equipo de trabajo dentro de un proyecto estable en nuestra organización (Netformix):

Netformic, una compañía alemana en proceso de expansión, líder en dar soluciones tecnológicas específicas a nuestros clientes de tamaño medianos pero conocidos, a varias startups y a equipos digitales de grandes empresas. ¡Sé parte de ayudarles a dominar el camino hacia la digitalización!

Remoto o local
Vivimos una cultura de "Remote First" que permite combinar las necesidades individuales con el trabajo diario. También ofrecemos un modelo híbrido en Málaga y otras ciudades, para quienes lo desean.
